items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: and you were in The Glenn Miller Story with Jimmy Stewart and June Allison.

ctx.x: Yeah, I guess that's it, it's not Memory Lane, I got it mixed up with another show. Yeah, Joe Franklin. He's still on, isn't he?

As far as I know, yeah. It's a local show that's been going for years. It says that you appeared in several films. We talked about Make Mine Music, and you were in The Glenn Miller Story with Jimmy Stewart and June Allison. How did they work in that one?
